result:
Frontend phase-01 of `002-us-tags` (US1: tag tasks and filter by tag) **passes**: all 6 checks pass, attempt 1. I ran them with headless Playwright against `/tasks` on the runner's fresh test database.

| Check | Acceptance criterion | Result |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | AC-US1-1: add "work, urgent" to a task | Both tags show, stay after a reload, and reading the task back from the API returns both |
| C2 | AC-US1-2: filter by "work" | Exactly the 5 tasks tagged "work" are listed; tasks tagged "home", "workshop" or nothing are not |
| C3 | AC-US1-3: remove "work" | The task shows only "home" and no longer appears under the "work" filter |
| C4 | AC-US1-4: empty tag, 31-character tag | Each is rejected with a message under the task ("tag must not be blank", "must be at most 30 characters"); the tags are unchanged |
| C5 | AC-US1-5: add "Work" to a task tagged "work", filter by "WORK" | The task still has one "work" tag, and the "WORK" filter lists it |
| C6 | AC-US1-6: add an 11th tag | Rejected with "must have at most 10 tags"; the 10 tags stay |

- **Browser console:** the only errors were the 3 expected 400 responses from the rejected adds.
- **Unit tests:** none are configured for the frontend (`outcome: none`).
- **Setup:** I created the 10 starting tasks with `fetch` from the page, because the shell blocked a loop of curl calls; the results are in `setup-tasks.json` in the evidence folder. All tagging, removing and filtering was done in the UI.
- **"Tags added" notice:** I saw it once, right after an add. It disappears after a short time, so later reads missed it. The acceptance criteria don't mention it.
- **Coverage gap:** BR-T4 (tags are deleted with their task) has no check in this phase, because none of its criteria cover deleting. Only the backend unit tests cover it.
